items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Maybe Ethel Waters, I don't know, but Bill Robertson, he was the only Black allowed in there.

ctx.x: That's all. That's all, to my knowledge. Maybe Ethel Waters, I don't know, but Bill Robertson, he was the only Black allowed in there.
Now, you say this is because he charmed his way in.
